title: Man in 1940s Double Breasted Suit, Jersey City B&W Snapshot 1949
back_text_transcription: Jersey City - Aunt Joe's Apt. June 9, 10, 11, 1949
description: A clear, well-framed black-and-white full-length portrait of a stylish young man standing on the brick steps outside an urban apartment building in Jersey City. He wears a classic late-1940s double-breasted pinstripe suit with broad lapels and cuffed trousers, styled with a high-volume pompadour hairstyle typical of post-WWII American menswear fashion. Handwritten notes on the reverse identify the date as June 9-11, 1949 at Aunt Joe's apartment.
